suites.name: go-unit
suites.cmd: env -u SPYDER_LIVE_UDID -u SPYDER_LIVE_UDIDS -u SPYDER_LIVE_BUNDLE_ID -u SPYDER_LIVE_WEDGE -u SPYDER_LIVE_ANDROID_SERIAL -u SPYDER_LIVE_APPRAISE_DEVICE go test -timeout 2m  ./...

suites.name: live
suites.reason: set SPYDER_LIVE_UDID=<udid> to run; requires a paired device

suites.name: live-appraise
suites.reason: set SPYDER_LIVE_APPRAISE_DEVICE=<android alias> to run; needs a device and a Claude login
